3-Hour Delivery prototype

Live-site rebuilds from the sh-components library, as they look today. The 3-Hour Delivery and Early AM proposals go on top of these.

Proposals

Each link opens the PLP with a starting setup; the review panel (bottom right of every page) switches the cutoff and the sample delivery time, and moves between pages. Settings carry across pages.
